scripts.start: AGENTS=2 BOOTSTRAP_PORT=28134 SIGNAL_PORT=29283 yarn run network
scripts.dev: VITE_ADMIN_PORT=22994 VITE_APP_PORT=29281 SIGNAL_PORT=29283 BOOTSTRAP_PORT=28134 UI_PORT=8888 yarn run x
scripts.dev:online: VITE_ADMIN_PORT=22994 VITE_APP_PORT=29281 SIGNAL_PORT=29283 BOOTSTRAP_PORT=28134 UI_PORT=8888 yarn run x:online
scripts.x: rm -r ui/node_modules; yarn run build:zomes && yarn build:graphql:adapter && yarn install && hc s clean && yarn run build:happ && UI_PORT=8888 concurrently "yarn workspace ui start" "yarn run start:happ" "hc run-local-services -b $BOOTSTRAP_PORT -s $SIGNAL_PORT"
scripts.x:online: hc s clean &&  yarn run build:happ && UI_PORT=8888 concurrently "yarn workspace ui start" "yarn run start:happ:online"
scripts.network: hc s clean && yarn run build:happ && UI_PORT=8888 concurrently "yarn workspace ui start" "yarn run launch:happ" "holochain-playground"
scripts.network:online: hc s clean && yarn run build:happ && UI_PORT=8888 concurrently "yarn workspace ui start" "yarn run launch:online" "holochain-playground"
scripts.test: rm -r tests/node_modules; yarn run build:zomes && yarn build:graphql:adapter && hc app pack workdir --recursive && yarn workspace tests run test
scripts.launch:happ1: echo "pass" | RUST_LOG=warn hc launch --piped -n $AGENTS workdir/hrea.happ --ui-port $UI_PORT network mem
scripts.package: rm -f ui/dist.zip && rm -rf ui/dist && yarn run build:happ && yarn workspace ui package && hc web-app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.start:happ: echo "starting with admin $VITE_ADMIN_PORT" && RUST_LOG=warn echo "pass" | hc s -f=$VITE_ADMIN_PORT --piped generate workdir/hrea.happ --run=$VITE_APP_PORT -a hrea network -b "http://127.0.0.1:$BOOTSTRAP_PORT"  webrtc "ws://127.0.0.1:$SIGNAL_PORT"
scripts.start:happ:online: echo "starting with admin $VITE_ADMIN_PORT" && RUST_LOG=warn echo "pass" | hc s -f=$VITE_ADMIN_PORT --piped generate workdir/hrea.happ  -s 1234 --run=$VITE_APP_PORT -a hrea network -b "https://bootstrap.holo.host/" webrtc "wss://signal-2.infra.holochain.org"
scripts.build:happ: yarn run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive
